card.name: Words right before lab or test
card.fires_on: Small words like a, an, the, to, or FDA-approved/authorized, placed just before an expected word such as laboratory, lab, or test. Seen in label text about sending samples or using approved tests.

modes.label: Articles before laboratory
modes.description: A, an or the (or to) right before laboratory or lab in sending or communicating about samples.
modes.example: Prepare serum samples and send to<< a>> laboratory for growth hormone determinations.

modes.label: Before FDA-approved test
modes.description: An or the hyphenated approved/authorized in FDA test wording for detecting mutations.
modes.example: Select patients for treatment with TAGRISSO based on the presence of a mutation as detected by<< an>> FDA-approved test.

card.writes: It pushes the model to predict lab, laboratory and labs as the next word.
card.plain: It fires on the small word just before the text says lab or laboratory, such as when samples are sent out for testing.
